_comment: Portal slot -> the image file(s) on this site, and the Cloudinary transform to fetch.
The slot names are NOT arbitrary. The client portal builds them itself:
five fixed slots (hero-home, logo, featured-1, about-team, blog-placeholder)
plus one per service, named hero-<slug>, where slug is the service name
lowercased with every run of non-alphanumerics replaced by a hyphen.
If a service is renamed in the Services sheet, its slot name changes with it
and this file must be updated or that slot silently stops publishing.
A slot may write more than one file. On this site each service has a wide
page hero (hero-service-N.webp) and a smaller card thumbnail (septic.webp
and friends) that appears on the other service pages. The client is offered
one photo per service, so one upload feeds both, cropped differently.
hero-service-N is positional on this site but the slot key is not: the map
below is explicit, so reordering services in the sheet cannot silently point
a photo at the wrong page.
Transforms are Cloudinary's, applied on the fly. c_fill with g_auto picks
the crop, which matters because clients upload whatever aspect ratio their
phone produced. The logo uses c_limit so it is scaled, never cropped.
